adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework recovered local PDF activity thresholds and mouse-protection regimens for the protein-free bactericidal fraction, reconciled APD6 AP00499 as citation-linked with database-only molecular annotations, and replaced the framework-test review with a paper-specific worker-6 adjudication.

source_review_depth.paper_xml: Opened raw paper.xml and xml_sections; NXML supplies metadata/abstract/PDF link but no body tables.
source_review_depth.paper_pdf: Opened extracted PDF text 249.txt and used line-located Table I-IV prose/table regions for activity, mechanism, and in vivo protection.
source_review_depth.oa_package: Opened archive manifest and raw OA package; package contains 249.nxml and 249.pdf.
source_review_depth.supplementary_assets: Opened supplementary index, supplementary_text/tables, and extraction_errors; no local supplementary assets exist for this 1939 article.
source_review_depth.merged_database_rows: Opened packet linked APD6 experiment and literature JSONL rows; no linked sequence, assay, or DRAMP rows exist.

materials_exhausted.note: Local materials are sufficient for the owner-layer repair. Unsupported APD6 molecular/later-annotation claims are preserved as database-only cautions, not blocking missing source values.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: The DOI/PMID/PMCID literature link is verified. APD6 AP00499 historical MBC subclaims match primary PDF thresholds, but exact gramicidin A sequence/modification/later APD6 annotations are database-only for this paper.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Recovered nine row-level source-located activity/protection records from PDF Table I-IV prose/table regions with endpoints, raw values, units, target species/strain, assay conditions, and locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are bounded to source-supported glucose-dehydrogenase inactivation, lysis as a secondary readout, and mouse protection; APD6 channel/NMR mechanism is not promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.review_layer: The prior framework-test blocker is closed because source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 artifacts now exist and remaining limitations are cautionary, not open rework.

caution_findings.evidence_context: The local primary article supports a protein-free bactericidal fraction and activity thresholds, but not the APD6 gramicidin A sequence, terminal modifications, D-residue pattern, NMR/channel structure, or later assay annotations.
NXML contains metadata/PDF link only; activity rows are grounded in local PDF text with line locators.
The OA package contains NXML/PDF only; supplementary index and extraction error log confirm no local supplementary files.
OCR of historical tables is partially garbled, so final rows use source prose for thresholds/regimens and do not fabricate every individual table cell.
